decisions.reason: The 2019 award places this probe clearly above aspiration levels relative to comparable offerings, so a large firm with slack would usually keep backing it despite limited later website evidence.

This probe shows no visible performance signal beyond launch, and if commercial uptake stayed below aspiration by 2022 management would likely redeploy resources rather than continue an uncertain line.
As a complementary geothermal surface technology with no clear success signal after introduction, it is vulnerable to problemistic search and resource reallocation when results remain ambiguous.
A fire-protection steel profile system fits the firm’s core metal capabilities and likely benefits from organisational slack, so management would tend to keep it unless results were clearly poor.
A slim steel profile system is close to the established business, and boundedly rational management would usually tolerate some uncertainty for a strategically adjacent product.
Although market evidence is thin, this decorative steel profile surface system remains related to the core portfolio, making continued retention somewhat more likely than withdrawal.
